messages:
jiayi: quick brain dump from morning pairing: instead of rewriting full shard for tiny edits, we could ship a compact sidecar that records (offset,len,data) patches and let the loader do a query-time merge. keeps base file immutable and avoids full checkpoint churn.

matt: sounds promising. two high-level modes: 1) on-demand apply (cheap writes, more read work) 2) background materialize (reads fast, more IO later). which do we start with? :ear

jiayi: start with on-demand apply for minimal infra changes. add background materialize as a compaction worker later.

aline: must enumerate failure modes: partial sidecar missing, corrupted patch, or race where compaction finishes while nodes still following old sidecars. need manifest-level versioning + leases.

tomas: propose manifest entries per shard: {shard_id, base_path, version, sidecar_index: [sidecar_path,...], lease_epoch}. loader checks manifest atomically and then reads base + listed sidecars in that order.

matt: ordering is important. sidecars should include parent_version in header so we can validate chain continuity. also include a small bloom or index keyed by 4k page so loader can avoid scanning whole sidecar.

jiayi: yepwe can store sidecar as: header(json)
--page-index(uint32 count) --entries[(page_idx:uint32, offset:uint64, len:uint32, data...)]
this lets loader seek page-index, find page-level records, and apply per-page overlays. keeps random IO bounded.

devx: SDK API suggestion: `weights.open_shard(base, manifest_uri, apply_sidecars=true)` and an option `materialize_after_apply=true|false` for background compaction trigger. Defaults should be conservative.

aline: telemetry: we need overlay_apply_count, overlay_page_reads, overlay_latency_p50/p95, overlay_verify_failures, compaction_duration. also surface read-amplification per-request so product teams can opt-out on latency-sensitive routes.

matt: security: for Private deployments require sidecars be signed. header fields: signer_id, signature(kms). Also validate size limits and reject huge sidecars that try to replace entire shard.

tomas: compaction design: distributed compaction worker acquires a shard-lease via coordinator, materializes a new base by applying all verified sidecars, writes a temp file `shard.vN.tmp`, fsync, then atomic rename to `shard.vN` and update manifest. After manifest update, older sidecars can be tombstoned and GCed after grace window.

ops-bot: note: will add compaction-worker skeleton to infra backlog. default GC grace = 24h; expose override as `gc_grace_hours` in manifest. emitting events: compaction.started, compaction.succeeded, compaction.failed.

jiayi: rollback story: manifest update must be an atomic swap of pointer. keep last N manifests in a small journal to support quick rollback. if compaction fails, do not remove sidecars.

devx: CLI UX: `rw-patch create --base base.safetensors --from updated.safetensors -o s1.sidecar` and `rw-patch inspect s1.sidecar` which prints page index and signed metadata. Make sidecar creation deterministic so diffs are reproducible.

matt: perf caveat: for dense edits many pages will be patched and overlay cost approaches rewrite. the compaction threshold should consider patched_page_count / total_pages ratio. Once > X% trigger immediate compaction.

aline: also enforce per-sidecar size cap (e.g., 32MB) to stop accidental huge deltas. bigger edits should be a full checkpoint publish.

tomas: on-disk layout note: keep sidecars co-located with base shard in object storage prefix e.g. `models/<model>/shards/<shard>/base.safetensors` + `sidecars/epoch-1234.bin`. reduces cross-listing. manifest lists relative paths.

ops-bot: question: how do nodes discover new manifests? poll interval vs push?

jiayi: start with short poll (10s) plus optional push via webhook for critical updates. we'll measure staleness.

matt: testing plan: unit tests for merge correctness, fuzzed corrupted sidecar rejects, e2e sim where compaction runs concurrent with readers. add perf microbench for overlay latency on NVM vs spinning disks.

devx: rollout: feature-flag behind `ENABLE_SIDECAR_PATCHES` and opt-in per-model via manifest field `allow_sidecars`. telemetry gates before wide rollout.

aline: docs: compatibility notes for older runtimes that don't understand sidecars -> they must refuse to load manifests listing sidecars, or fallback to explicit `materialized_base` paths. Include migration tools.

jiayi: I'll draft a short RFC + proto layout and ping you all for review. will include example `manifest.json` snippet and a tiny loader reference.

matt: thanks. add checklist: signature policy, compaction lease invariants, GC window, and metrics dashboard panels.

tomas: +1. also include simple script to simulate page-index lookups so we can validate read amplification numbers.

ops-bot: created issue #infra/sidecar-compaction to track work items.
